content:
AZ-104 validates the skills to implement, manage and monitor an Azure environment. Skills measured (official study guide):

  • Manage Azure identities and governance: 20–25%
  • Implement and manage storage: 15–20%
  • Deploy and manage Azure compute resources: 20–25%
  • Implement and manage virtual networking: 15–20%
  • Monitor and maintain Azure resources: 10–15%

Check the official study guide for the latest changes before your exam.

• Create and manage users and groups in Microsoft Entra ID, including bulk operations and guest (external) users
  • Azure RBAC: assign built-in roles (Owner, Contributor, Reader, User Access Administrator) at management group, subscription, resource group or resource scope
  • Governance: Azure Policy, resource locks, tags, management groups, Cost Management budgets and alerts

• Configure redundancy (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS) and access tiers (Hot, Cool, Cold, Archive) with lifecycle management
  • Secure access with shared access signatures (SAS), stored access policies, access keys and Entra ID-based access
  • Azure Files shares and Azure File Sync; blob versioning, soft delete and object replication; storage firewalls and private endpoints

section_title: Deploy and manage Azure compute resources
content:
• Automate deployments with ARM templates and Bicep
  • Virtual machines: sizes, disks and disk encryption, availability sets and availability zones, VM Scale Sets
  • Containers: Azure Container Registry, Azure Container Instances, Azure Container Apps
  • Azure App Service: plans, scaling, deployment slots, custom domains and TLS, backups

• Virtual networks, subnets and VNet peering; user-defined routes
  • Network security groups (NSGs) and application security groups; Azure Bastion for secure RDP/SSH
  • Service endpoints and private endpoints; Azure DNS (public and private zones)
  • Azure Load Balancer (layer 4, internal or public) and troubleshooting with Network Watcher

• Azure Monitor metrics, logs (Log Analytics/KQL), alerts and action groups; VM, storage and network insights
  • Azure Backup with Recovery Services vaults and Backup vaults, backup policies and restores
  • Azure Site Recovery for VM replication and failover between regions
